design_name: Preliminary scheme P1 — north-side core, mid-depth
concept_statement: One fixed core (stair, glass elevator, lobby) sits in a 7-ft strip on the north side at x 8–26, so the full 30-ft ocean face is free on every level: living terrace on L1, ocean suite on L2, bed + shower on L3, infinity pool on the roof. Two transverse structural lines (x=26, x=40) plus the east face carry the pool loads to the piles.
core_strategy: Stair 12×7 (U-stair), glass elevator 6×7, lobby 12×5 south of the core; identical x,y on all five levels.
rooftop_option_A_room_names: Covered Gourmet · outdoor kitchen + granite wet-bar counter (Option A core)
pool_equipment_location: Ground-level mechanical room (40,18) on an elevated platform at or above BFE+1 ft, with the alternative of a screened equipment closet inside the rooftop bath/stair block; final location per flood and structural review.
front_entry_stair: Exterior L-shaped stair in the 20-ft front zone, ~12×6 ft footprint, 4 ft wide, rising from the driveway to the L1 entry foyer at the west face; open (no walls) so it reads as an allowed projection — confirm under §4.23.
tradeoffs: Glass elevator looks east through the interior (not directly onto the ocean) on L1–L3; full ocean view at the roof stop.
Structural line x=40 crosses the L1 great room as a beam line (dining / living zones) — no interior columns needed if the 30-ft transverse beam is accepted by the engineer.
Two city suites on L2 are 14 × 11.5 ft; one is entered through a dressing vestibule.
